newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Opposition-led strike hits Pakistan's bourse.
newsitem.headline: Opposition-led strike hits Pakistan's bourse.

text.p: Karachi Stock Exchange officials opened the trading hall on Thursday despite an opposition-led strike in the city but traders said there was no trade.
"Brokers have not reported any trades in the first 45 minutes of the trade," said one broker.
On Wednesday, Karachi bourse's 100-share index closed 19.87 points, or 1.42 percent, down at 1,383.32 with 161 losers and 58 gainers.
